# Mini FAR

<!-- section: abstract -->
## Abstract

A small firm registers in SAM.gov before most awards, and the Phase II requirements differ by agency, so the route matters [1] [2].

<!-- section: 1-intro -->
## 1. Introduction

<!-- figure: mini-table -->

Phase II follows Phase I for firms that show feasibility, and the SAM registration is the first gate on almost every route the agencies describe [1][3].

Taken together, these sources describe one sequence that no single source states end to end for a small firm. <!-- synthesis -->
The rest of this section walks through that sequence for readers who have not met it before and want the overview.
